svg.title: Mendoza (Uco, Luján de Cuyo) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Luján de Cuyo; 2: Uco Valley; 3: Perdriel; 4: Maipú; 5: Tupungato; 6: Tunuyán; 7: San Carlos; 8: La Consulta; 9: San Rafael; 10: Bermejo; 11: San Roque; 12: La Paz

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
